summary: ROUND 2 (G3-core D-RW1, D-RW2): an unlearned R_psi of either sign could be promoted by the round-1 rule (a random initialisation is a random function of informative inputs; the round-1 null 'R_psi independent of outcomes' was the wrong one), so round 1's promotions did not show learning. Fix: lowering the mix also requires beating 20 never-trained control rewards (R_psi's own initialisation psi_0 + 19 seeded draws) and their negations (intersection-union test at alpha/2; validity_placebos). Measured on RW's controlled 600-decision configuration with G3-core's seeds: unlearned R_psi promoted 0 of 20 (frozen, both signs; the round-1 rule acted on 3), 0 of 10 drifting without learning, 0 of 6 frozen; learned 0 of 9 at 600 and 0 of 3 at 1200 decisions (best learned agreement 0.38 vs the best control's 0.26). D-RW2 justified (structural with a tied reward-time bootstrap) and reported as reason 'mixture_and_R_psi_rank_alike_at_reward_time'. || ROUND 1: RW (amendment 2026-11-28 item 1, genuinely learned rewards). Audit: the mix stayed 1 because the promotion test compared single policy steps (power ~0 at realistic rates), existed only at applied meta-updates, and the outer estimator used only the 3-4 decisions between two live updates; defect: level readings were stored as the level. Changed (reward/): prospective anytime-valid validity evidence decides the mix (no margin, no held-out reservation); pooled first-order outer estimator ('auto' default, query-window fallback); outer utility default 'direct'; level readings as changes; ST-3 information value as a bootstrap input. Debug scale, one long LabWorld objective per seed vs a frozen R_psi (same seeds, controlled configuration without goal term): learning raised R_psi's prospective agreement with verified outcomes above the frozen R_psi's in 17/18 seed-configurations; with the final rule (pairs only within one psi) the evidence promoted R_psi in 3/3 600-decision objectives at reward lr 3e-3 and 2/6 at the agent's 1e-4 (frozen: 0 of 12), decisions changed 7-31 decisions later; afterwards the chosen actions' true value over the frozen counterfactual was +2.14 [1.63, 2.64] adopters/decision in the one objective with a long post-promotion period (319 decisions) and inconclusive in the four short ones (-2.89 .. +0.87, all intervals include 0): improvement not established. Integrated agent (debug, 120 decisions, agent configuration): 9/143 meta-updates applied, 47 pairs, no promotion. Real configuration (Qwen3-4B + 50m, backbone on, one GPU hold): 35 decisions, 4/36 meta-updates applied, 17 pairs, e-value 1.0, mix 1, R_psi weight 0 in all 11 live updates. Not shown: promotion or improvement on the real model; reliable improvement in general.
